name: Central Sector Scholarship Scheme
subtitle: Ministry of Education, Govt of India
desc: Central sector scholarship for college and university students from J&K who were meritorious in Class 12, subject to family income criteria.

name: J&K Prime Minister's Special Scholarship Scheme (PMSSS)
subtitle: AICTE / J&K Government
desc: Special scholarship scheme enabling J&K domicile students to pursue professional and undergraduate courses at institutes outside the Union Territory.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
subtitle: Ministry of Education
desc: Scholarship for meritorious students of economically weaker sections studying in Classes 9 to 12 in J&K government schools.

name: J&K Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
subtitle: Social Welfare Department, J&K
desc: State post-matric scholarship scheme covering tuition and maintenance allowance for eligible SC/ST/OBC students in J&K.
